comment: The game's palette, as ramps from dark to light. The first ten ramps are the 40 colours of the kit (pixellab-kit/6-terne/0-palette): every pixel of the world's art is one of them. The ramps after them are for characters only (docs/art-guide.md): skin tones from deep to fair, and faded reds for hair and cloth. The 3D characters are drawn in these colours only.
